description: Return resolved outages published on the carrier outage registers required by the ACMA (Telstra, Optus, TPG Telecom for Vodafone, and nbn) by provider (provider_slug), postcode or state, newest first. For a provider that uses another network, the entries come from that host network's register and are labelled as on that network. Returns up to 10 entries, each with its source link; the offset parameter returns the next entries among the first 30. These are records of resolved outages, not current network status.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip; a result gives the value for the next page as next_offset. Only the first 30 entries can be paged

outage_type.description: major = over 100,000 services or a whole state or territory; significant_local = smaller outages above the ACMA local thresholds

postcode.description: Australian postcode, four digits, e.g. 2320 or 0870

provider_slug.description: Provider slug, e.g. telstra, optus, boost-mobile; nbn for nbn

name: get_outage_history

areas.description: Up to 5 affected areas as published

ended_on.description: End date, Australia/Sydney, ISO date; null when the register published an end before the start

published_by.description: Carrier that published the register entry

resolved_by.description: Carrier the register names as responsible for resolving the outage

error.description: Error code, present only on an error result

filters_applied.description: The lookup that was applied, echoed from the request

message.description: User-facing error message, present only on an error result

next_offset.description: Offset for the next entries; null when there are no more, or the 30-entry paging limit is reached

title: Resolved outage history
